youtube.title: ₹5,000 SIP se ₹50 Lakh? Phir Itna Slow Kyun Lagta Hai #Shorts
youtube.description:
₹5,000 ka monthly SIP ₹50 lakh ban sakta hai. Toh phir pehle 5 saal SIP itna bekaar kyun lagta hai? Compounding ki growth late dikhti hai, aur zyaadatar log teesre saal mein hi SIP band kar dete hain.
पहले 5 साल SIP धीमा लगता है, असली ग्रोथ बाद में आती है।

Is video ke numbers (12% per year maan kar, sirf example):
• 5 saal: ₹3 lakh daale → ~₹4.1 lakh
• 10 saal: ₹6 lakh daale → ~₹11.6 lakh
• 20 saal: ₹12 lakh daale → ~₹50 lakh
Real returns upar-neeche hote hain, koi guarantee nahi hai.

Aapka SIP kitne saal se chal raha hai? Comment karo 👇

📌 Sirf educational content. SEBI-registered nahi. Investment advice nahi.
